title: Example 131: a backoff that gained a multiplier, related to the doubling record by building it from the new components
description: Regression proof of net.terminalvalue.crosscut.retry.Backoff#delayMillis across a component added to the record: the previous two-component Backoff is built from the new one's base and cap by a constructor call among --before-arguments (new Backoff(this.baseMillis, this.capMillis), attempt), with this.multiplier != 2 as the scope. The loop kept counting up with the cap applied after it: expected verified, about 17 s inline with JBMC at unwind 32.

resources.notes: the last run used a stale jvmcontract; measured by the submitting sessions in seconds at under 200 MiB, except 142 at bound 8, 7 s
